events.title: 🎉 We’ve Reached 2,000 Wishlists!
events.summary: A huge thank-you to everyone who wishlisted our game and played the demo! ❤️ Your feedback and suggestions truly mean a lot to us. We’re currently working on new systems and content for the full version. We’re also planning to share the most up-to-date version of our demo before Steam Next Fest. Our full-release trailer will be coming very soon! Thank you again for your support. Release date: November 13, 2026.

events.title: Thanks for 1,000 Wishlists!
events.summary: Thank you so much to everyone who wishlisted our game and played the demo. Your feedback and suggestions genuinely matter to us. We're currently working on new systems and content for the full game, doing our best to make it as fun as possible. Our release date: November 13, 2026.

events.title: Demo Update: Piñatas Now Break Apart
events.summary: What's New Piñatas break apart. The piñata you hit no longer just disappears. It bursts into pieces and scatters across the stage. The light sits right in your hand. Movement is smoother and the light goes exactly where you want it. You can set cursor sensitivity to your own taste in the options. Fixes Fixed the light catching and jumping. Fixed issues with the pause menu. Fixed text and translation errors. The demo is free and updates automatically. Full release on November 13.
